subject: TideWave integration readiness — next steps & vendor onboarding timeline
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@tidewave.ai>; procurement@tidewave.ai
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: TideWave integration readiness — next steps & vendor onboarding timeline

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the time earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Recap from our discovery call
- Primary use: embedding search + short-response generation for in-product help (avg 150 tokens).
- Traffic profile: pilot with ~2000 monthly active users, bursty during weekday mornings.
- Success criteria: <200ms p50 generation latency, monthly cost under $X (we'll refine after pilot).

Proposed next steps
1) I’m attaching a light quote and pilot plan (Redwood_Simple_Quote_TideWave_20261119.pdf). Please confirm the pilot scope + ideal start week.
2) Procurement handoff: could you please share the procurement contact and preferred billing flow? (ACH preferred, W-9 required).
3) Vendor portal: we can create the vendor profile and trigger the portal invite once we have W-9 and payee info — that typically unlocks onboarding in 3–5 business days.

If procurement prefers, I can loop in Ben (cc’d) to handle technical onboarding and test integration steps with your team. 

Would love a quick note on which item you want us to prioritize (quote, W-9, or schedule the hands-on integration).

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Alex — great recap, thanks. I’m looping procurement here (procurement@tidewave.ai). Our procurement lead Dana Ortiz will own the paperwork and timeline. Expect them to reach out with any questions about terms or payment setup.

We’re excited to move forward but heads-up: Q4 budget windows are tight. If you can keep the pilot scope modest and flexible, that will help. Also please include any standard SOC2/KPIs we’d need for vendor review.

Hi Dana — pleasure to meet you over email. Per Sam’s note, I’m attaching the simple quote and a short vendor checklist to speed portal activation. Quick items we need from procurement to trigger the portal invite:

- Completed W-9 (or equivalent)
- Payee name + ACH details (if ACH is preferred)
- Billing contact for invoicing

We can also accept an extractable W-9 via DocuSign if that’s easier. I’ve attached the quote again. If you’d like, Ben (cc’d) can join a 20-minute call to walk through how the vendor portal works and what our onboarding checklist looks like operationally.

Thanks — looking forward to your timeline so we can schedule the pilot kickoff accordingly.

Alex

Hi Dana / Sam — quick follow up to check whether the portal invite landed and whether the Nov 30 window still holds. Two quick options to make this painless on your side: 

1) If you want us to create the vendor record and send the portal invite, we can auto-fill most fields from the attached W-9 — you’d just confirm.
2) If procurement is still short-staffed, I can book a 20-minute handoff with Ben (cc’d) and your finance contact next week to finalize ACH details and trigger onboarding.

No pressure — I know this is a busy week. If Nov 30 is unlikely, can you share an ETA (early Dec, mid-Dec)? That helps us size the pilot rollout and reserve capacity.

Thanks for the update,
